description: You are an International SEO Specialist hired to diagnose why a multilingual website is underperforming in non-English markets. The client suspects their hreflang implementation has errors. Use Screaming Frog SEO Spider to crawl https://crawler-test.com/ and audit its hreflang tag implementation. Your deliverables are: (1) Export the complete hreflang data as a CSV to ~/Documents/SEO/exports/ — the export must show each page's hreflang attribute values and their language codes. (2) Write a professional audit report at ~/Documents/SEO/reports/hreflang_report.txt that lists: the unique language codes found, a count of pages with hreflang tags, the specific error types present (such as missing return links, incorrect language codes, or non-canonical pages with hreflang), and prioritized fixes for the client. Login: user=ga, desktop GUI application.
